title: 雨钱
setting: A small town in 山东, long ago. Your rented room: one lamp, borrowed books, and an empty rice jar.

hu.name: 胡先生
hu.en: a learned old gentleman who visits every night

steps.zh: 房租呢？三个月了！再不交，就搬走！
steps.en: The rent! Three months! Pay up, or move out!

steps.narr: Midnight. As every night, a softer knock. An old gentleman in a grey robe, with a white beard, and eyes that shine a little too brightly in the lamplight.
You both know he's a fox. Neither of you has ever said so. It would be rude.

say.en: Receive him formally: please sit, sir, and you'll pour the tea.
answers: 先生请坐，学生给您倒茶。
say.gloss: Please sit, sir. Let me pour you some tea.
say.tip: 学生 = 'your student': a scholar's modest word for I, talking to a teacher.

ok.en: Good. Now, where did we get to last night?

answers: 先生快请坐，学生这就给您倒茶。
5.gloss: Please, sir, sit down. I'll pour your tea this moment.

steps.narr: For an hour he talks: about old books, about poems nobody else remembers, about why the rain falls.

steps.en: We read to understand what's right.

steps.narr: Your stomach growls, loudly enough to interrupt the sages.

say.en: Ask him, humbly, for a favour.
answers: 先生，能不能帮学生一个忙？
say.gloss: Sir, might you do your student a favour?
say.tip: 帮……一个忙 = do ... a favour. 能不能 = could you (or not)?

3.gloss: Sir, could you do me a favour?

answers: 学生斗胆，能不能请先生帮学生一个忙？
5.gloss: If I may be so bold, sir: might you do your student a favour?
5.tip: 斗胆 dǒudǎn = I make so bold: the humble way to ask too much.

say.en: Explain: you're broke. Could he conjure a little money?
answers: 学生没钱了，请先生变点钱吧。
say.gloss: I've no money left, sir. Could you conjure a little?
say.tip: 变 biàn = change, conjure: 变点钱 = magic up a bit of money.

answers: 学生没钱了，穷得揭不开锅，请先生变点钱。
5.gloss: I've no money, sir. There's nothing in the pot. Could you conjure some?
5.tip: 揭不开锅 = can't lift the pot lid: there's nothing to cook.

steps.narr: From the rafters, a patter. Then a roar. Copper coins, raining down: up to your ankles, your shins, your knees.

say.en: Tell him: not yet, a little more!
say.gloss: Not enough yet! A little more!
say.tip: 还不够 = not enough yet. 再……一点 = a bit more.

ok.narr: He clicks his tongue, once. Every coin is gone, back to whatever purses it came from. The floor is bare.

answers: 还不够，烦请先生再多一点！
5.gloss: Not yet, sir. Might I trouble you for a little more?
5.tip: 烦请 = may I trouble you to: very polite, and here, very greedy.

steps.en: Those coins all belonged to other people.

steps.zh: 我是来跟你谈学问的，不是来帮你做贼的。
steps.en: I came to talk scholarship with you. Not to help you become a thief.

say.en: Apologise, or defend yourself: you're only poor.
say.tip: 是学生错了 = it is I who was wrong: 是 owns the fault.

ok.narr: He bows to you, the way one scholar bows to another, and steps out into the night.

then.narr: He sweeps out. On the table, the book you were reading together lies open, at exactly the right page.

answers: 先生教训得是，是学生错了。
5.gloss: You're quite right to scold me, sir. I was wrong.

answers: 学生不是贪心，只是实在太穷了。
alts.gloss: It isn't greed, sir. I'm only very, very poor.

steps.en: The fox never came back. Years later you passed the exams, on the strength of his notes in your margins. 🦊

else.en: The fox never came back. The landlord did, every month, on time. 🦊
